items.english: "Very well. Have it all your own way," Mitsuyo flung out after her usual manner, and turned away in a sulk. Zenpei, as though it were no concern of his, with the mine on his lips at every second word, his heart scarcely present in his body.

Rough upon the mats, venting herself upon the sliding doors, Mitsuyo went out of the room. Just then Tatsuya was passing along the corridor that leads to the main house. They met face to face, one above and one below, and Tatsuya smiled at her as he always did. Mitsuyo, her face set in a pout, turned her eyes away toward the ridge. Tatsuya smiled and passed on.
notes: I kept "one above and one below" as written, though the levels in the inn are not made clear; the point is a brief meeting and her turning away.

items.english: As he had said, Zenpei hastened to leave while it was still early morning. Though shown no more tenderness today, Mitsuyo's face did not soften, yet her heart was already glad to be out of this house. Tatsuya came out to see them off. At sight of him Mitsuyo knit her brows and turned her face away. Tatsuya and Zenpei whispered together for a little, and ended laughing with one another. Mitsuyo pretended not to know and looked only elsewhere. At parting Tatsuya had one word: "Mitsuyo-san, when you meet Tsunao-san, please remember me kindly to him."
notes: "Remember me kindly to him" renders a set polite formula; I left its sting to context rather than stressing it.

data.say: Drafted p90 to p92 with Mitsuyo's sulk, the corridor meeting, and the cool departure kept plain.
